semantic_insights: The complete submitted root record is the sole scoring unit. File collections and other nested properties were considered at their actual locations without creating child scores or inheriting collection metadata.
The empty caller applicability context leaves all conditional predicates unknown. All 50 items remain in the denominator, regardless of the record's own human-subject or access statements.

Explicit platform access instructions, release changes, acquisition methods, research objectives, raw-source derivation, and hosting information were credited in their actual populated fields rather than requiring duplicate dedicated fields.
The distinction between the latest-version DOI and version 1.1.0's DOI resolves the apparent identifier difference between the root identifier and recommended citation.
The record separates pediatric release evidence from adult-dataset facts and identifies where wider protocol statements supply context.

Seven internal consistency checks passed: human-subject status versus ethics approval; human-subject status versus consent; participant and recording counts across fields; compatibility of smaller SPARC feature counts with disclosed omissions; latest-version versus release-specific DOI roles; funding attribution versus purpose; and agreement among version dates, distribution dates, and issued date.

Software documentation meets the processing-role threshold because b2aiprep and the named feature-extraction tools produced or transformed released data. Capture software and hosting platforms were not used to substitute for processing-software evidence.
Correctness assessment was limited to the supplied record, identifier syntax, plausible domains, and internal consistency. No external source, URL reachability, or award verification was performed.
